passage: Farhan, sit down. I'll tell you something from when I was fifteen, now that you've got your first phone. I'm Ganga, remember? A group at my school kept saying, "Send us a private picture, everyone does." They teased me too: "Still no boyfriend? What's wrong with you?" I laughed it off for weeks, then felt sick every time my phone buzzed. One evening a girl said she would show everyone my messages unless I sent something. My hands went cold, but I thought, these are mine. I sent nothing. That night I told my mother, and she went to the principal with me. The teasing died down after that.

qa.q: How old was Ganga when the group started asking for a private picture?
What was Ganga feeling when a girl threatened to show everyone the messages?
qa.a: Ganga was frightened, with cold hands, yet clear that the pictures and messages were Ganga's own.

qa.q: What could Farhan do if a group pushes for private pictures?
qa.a: Send nothing, and tell a trusted adult, especially if anyone threatens to spread messages, as Ganga did with Ganga's mother.

qa.q: How might Ganga's mother have seen Ganga coming to her?
qa.a: Likely with worry but also trust; she went to the principal with Ganga straight away, which shows she took it seriously and stood beside Ganga.

grounding: Ganga recalls friends demanding private pictures and teasing, refusing to send anything and telling an adult when threatened.

passage:
The boys' group chat had been at Chaitanya for a week. "Still no girlfriend? What's wrong with you?" Then, on Thursday night, Vicky wrote, "Ask Seema for a pic. A real one. Or send us one of yours from the changing room. Prove you're not a baby."

Chaitanya sat on his bed in the Andheri flat, phone heavy in his hand. He typed, "Not doing that," and put the phone face down. His ears were hot.

The replies kept coming. Then Vicky posted: "Fine. I have that pic of you from swimming. Maybe the whole class should see it."

Chaitanya's heart hammered. He took screenshots of everything and left the group.

He walked into the living room where his father was watching the news. "Papa, can I show you something? Someone's threatening to share a photo of me."

His father read the screenshots, went very still, then said, "You did the right thing. We're calling your class teacher first thing, and I'm messaging Vicky's parents tonight."

qa.q: What did Vicky threaten to do with the swimming photo?
qa.a: Vicky threatened that the whole class should see it.

qa.q: What was Chaitanya feeling when Vicky made the threat?
qa.a: Chaitanya felt frightened, with his heart hammering, and humiliated by the week of teasing.

qa.q: Which steps did Chaitanya take that protected him?
qa.a: Chaitanya refused, took screenshots, left the group and showed his father the same night, which put a trusted adult in charge.

qa.q: How might Seema feel if she learned the boys wanted Chaitanya to ask her for a photo?
qa.a: Seema would likely feel uncomfortable and disrespected, and grateful that Chaitanya refused to ask.

grounding: It shows a teen pressed by friends to share private photos and teased for not dating, who refuses and tells an adult when someone threatens to spread a photo.

passage:
"So when are you getting a girlfriend, Tarun?" Sahil tossed the cricket ball from hand to hand.

"No plans."

"No plans. Everyone in our batch has someone. Or at least talks to someone." Sahil grinned. "Rohit's girl sent him pictures. You've got nothing to show."

"I don't want anything to show."

"Come on. At least send a shirtless one to that girls' group. For fun."

Tarun caught the ball mid-toss. "No. That's mine. I'm not sending pictures of myself to anyone, and I'm not asking anyone for theirs."

"Relax, man."

"I am relaxed. And if Rohit's showing people her pictures, that's not okay either. She'd probably hate that."

Sahil stopped grinning. "…He did show us."

"Then he shouldn't have. Tell him, or I will. And if he's threatening her with them, that's for a teacher, not us."

Sahil was quiet. "Yeah. I'll tell him."

They went back to bowling.

qa.q: What did Sahil ask Tarun to send to the girls' group?
qa.a: Sahil asked Tarun to send a shirtless picture to the girls' group.

qa.q: What might Sahil be feeling when he stops grinning?
qa.a: Sahil seems uneasy and a little ashamed, realising that Rohit showing the pictures was not okay.

qa.q: What could the boys do if Rohit keeps showing the pictures?
qa.a: They could tell him to stop and, if he threatens her, bring it to a teacher or another trusted adult rather than handling it alone.

qa.q: How might Rohit's girlfriend feel if she knew her pictures were being shown?
qa.a: She would probably feel betrayed and humiliated, since she sent them privately and never agreed to others seeing them.

grounding: It shows a teen teased for not dating and pushed to share photos, who says his body and messages are his and points to an adult if anyone threatens to spread pictures.
